step: provide 100 mm double side polished <100> Si wafers
locator: p.1 Abstract; p.1 Sec. II-A; p.7 Acknowledgment

step: pattern wafer backsides by standard lithography
locator: p.1 Sec. II-A; p.2 Sec. II-A
notes: Purpose of backside pattern not stated.

step: reactive ion etching (RIE) of backside Si
sputter TiW barrier/adhesion layer on frontside
sputter Cu seed layer on TiW
standard lithography patterning of micro-bumps
notes: Lithography optimized for 250 um features (p.3 Sec. III).

step: electroplate Cu (copper sulfate chemistry)
locator: p.2 Sec. II-A; p.2 Table I

step: electroplate Sn (tin methane sulfonic chemistry)
split: Sn plated on: a both wafers; b bottom wafer only; c top wafer only
locator: p.2 Sec. II-A; p.2 Table I

step: electroplate In (indium sulfamate bath)
material: indium sulfamate bath (Indium Corporation), In pellet anode
split: In plated on: a both wafers; b top wafer only; c bottom wafer only
locator: p.2 Sec. II-A; p.2 Table I

step: measure plated feature thickness with contact profilometer after each plating step
result: Cu, Sn, In targets within +-0.3 um over the wafers
notes: Done after each plating step; one row for the three checks.

step: strip photoresist
result: large fraction of 10 um features lost
locator: p.2 Sec. II-A; p.3 Sec. III
notes: Text lists strip with patterning; Sec. III places it after electrodeposition.

step: wet-etch field metallization (Cu seed, TiW)
result: smallest (10 um) features missing or damaged
locator: p.2 Sec. II-A; p.3 Sec. III; p.3 Fig. 3
notes: Order after strip from Sec. III.

step: clean wafers with organic solvents to remove organic residues
citric acid treatment of bonding surfaces
notes: Follows solvent clean ('prior to citric acid treatment'); purpose not stated.

step: face-to-face wafer-to-wafer alignment
equipment: EVG SmartView NT2 semiautomated W2W aligner

step: place metallized wafers in contact in bonder
heat wafers to bonding temperature
split: bonding temperature: a 200 C (EVG #2) / 170 C (EVG #3); b 250 C (EVG #1); c 200 C (EVG #4)

step: apply contact force and hold for bonding time
conditions: 4.3 kN, ~17 MPa over 2.52 mm2 bump area, 1 h; same force and time as Aalto
locator: p.2 Sec. II-B; p.2 Sec. II-C; p.3 Fig. 2

step: cool down; bond formed (metal interdiffusion alloy)
scanning acoustic microscopy (C-SAM) of bonded wafer pairs
result: many chips bonded; notable fraction of u-bumps not formed (Fig. 5, 6)
locator: p.2 Sec. II-B; p.3 Sec. III-A

step: load wafers into AML-AWB-04 bonder and rough-align at ambient temperature and pressure
conditions: storage time between plating and bonding < 24 h

step: pump down bonding chamber and preheat to 75 C
fine alignment of wafer pair
make contact and apply bonding force
conditions: 4.3 kN, ~17 MPa over 2.52 mm2 bump area

step: heat at controlled ramp to 200 C and hold 1 h at temperature and pressure
locator: p.2 Sec. II-C; p.2 Table I

step: switch heaters off, release pressure, cool to 150 C, vent and unload
conditions: cool approximately 1 h until 150 C before venting

step: dice bonded wafer pairs into chips
result: EVG #2 and #4 detached; others survived except 10 um bump chips
locator: p.2 Sec. II-D; p.4 Sec. III-B

step: attach metal stiffener ring to package
split: Cu L/t (DOE1, DOE5); Cu L/t-0.5 mm (DOE2); Cu L+2 mm/t (DOE3); SUS L/t (DOE4)
locator: p.2 Sec. II-A; p.4 Table IV; p.6 Table VI; p.8 Sec. IV
notes: Attach material and temperature history not stated.

step: mold with EMC (process standard)
chip-on-wafer (wafer) underfill
split: UF-A process standard (DOE1-4, no-stiffener) / UF-B lower CTE (DOE5)
locator: p.1 Abstract; p.2 Table II; p.6 Table VI

step: C4 underfill (process standard)
BGA pad surface treatment
BGA solder ball attach
locator: p.2 Table I; p.2 Table II

step: provide 4-inch Si wafer
single-sided SiO2 by CVD (DRIE etch stop; blocks silicone grease)
locator: p.4 Sec. III-B; p.4 Fig. 3(a); p.5 Sec. III-B

step: spin photoresist on the other side
define TSV pattern by lithography
etch through vias by DRIE
target: TSV 30 um diameter, 60 um pitch, AR >= 10:1
notes: Through-etched; no blind via or CMP reveal.

step: remove photoresist in acetone
remove backside SiO2 in diluted HF
global SiO2 by thermal oxidation for insulation
TiN by ALD on both wafer sides successively
notes: Thickness = TiN on TSV sidewall ('more than 200 nm').

step: sputter Al on TiN
paste UV tape on opposite side (tight, bubble-free) for vacuum handling
notes: Applied after DRIE per text; drawn at step (i).

step: spin thick photoresist and define top wiring pattern
conditions: thick resist; increased dose; static hold before spinning; quick litho (tape adhesion drops after soft-bake)

step: ICP etch of Al/TiN to form top surface pattern
flip wafer and apply UV tape on opposite side
repeat thick-resist lithography for bottom wiring pattern
ICP etch to form bottom surface pattern
design, fabricate and test qubit chiplets (I) and bus chiplets (II) separately
pick and assemble chiplets by indium-based TCB on Al/TiN/In TSV interposer in I-II-I order
bump TSV interposer onto superconducting MCM (S-MCM)
attach heat sink to S-MCM with serrated nesting structure
pin out SMA ports from interposer through S-MCM and heat sink to test base
